comment: The reset button and the reset input share one dsp::SchmittTrigger, fed first with the button and then with the jack inside a single || expression (src/MentalClockDivider.cpp:69). Because the trigger is handed two different values in the same sample it goes low on one call and high on the next, which means a steady high voltage at the reset input fires a reset on every sample rather than once; that is why the lines say the reset holds rather than fires once. The divider order in the code (src/MentalClockDivider.cpp:40) matches the /2 /4 /8 /16 /32 /3 /5 /7 /12 printed down the panel. The panel prints ClkDiv, Clk In and Reset.
